blocking_findings.reason: Layer-2 toxicity evidence omits a material primary-source value/conflict. The source results text reports BotrAMP14 hemolysis IC50 approximately 92 uM, Table 1 lists BotrAMP14 hemolytic activity 128 uM, and Supplementary Figure S1 visually supports an approximate crossing between the 62.7 uM and 125 uM points. Current final toxicity_records contain the Table 1 128 uM row and S1 percent-hemolysis points, but the 92 uM IC50 remains only in candidate_or_rejected_rows[25,33] and has no accepted row, source-reviewed exclusion, or caution. This is a material toxicity/selectivity value omitted from the accepted final.
